title: Critique: integrated information theory forbids a conscious whole and part

statements.text: Integrated information theory’s exclusion postulate forbids two conscious subjects in a part-whole relation, so it is strictly inconsistent with hybrid cosmopsychism, on which both the universe and a person are conscious at once. Goff adopts a modified theory, IIT*, that is empirically indiscernible from the original and finds the exclusion postulate weakly justified.

sources.quote: IIT is strictly speaking inconsistent with hybrid cosmopsychism
